cues: Now the light reaction, drawn as the famous Z-scheme.
Height means the energy of an electron.
Two photosystems work in series: photosystem two, with reaction centre P680, and photosystem one, with P700.
The numbers are the wavelengths each absorbs best, and both are chlorophyll a.
